title: My First SaaS Project Just Hit $11K/Month
description:
Vadim is 19 years old and, before this year, had never shipped an app in his life.  In March, he quit his marketing job to build apps… 5 months later, he hit $10K/month with over 20K users. 

His process has been 100% building with AI and posting content on IG shamelessly.  This video is proof that you do NOT need to be technical or have a clever growth hack to build an app business that makes real money.
